games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

games.title: STAR WARS™ Empire at War - Gold Pack
games.description: Command or corrupt an entire galaxy in the definitive Star Wars strategy collection. It is a time of galactic civil war. Will you take up the reins of the Rebellion, assume control of the Empire, or rule the Star Wars Underworld?

games.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
games.description: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

games.title: 孤狼之春
games.description: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.

games.title: Fished Out
games.description: Fish, flee, and gamble your way to quota in this 1-4 player roguelike. Fight every catch, haul it aboard, avoid demonic beasts, and make it back to the ship with just enough time to bet it all at the casino. Miss quota and the sea takes every coin. One wrong cast could cost everything.

games.title: 魔塔-织梦
games.description: A turn-based RPG featuring classic Magic Tower gameplay. Climb through tower floors, collect keys and gold, fight monsters in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord and the Princess at the tower’s peak. There are three distinct endings.

games.title: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES
games.description: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

games.title: Seek Futa!
games.description: This is a "collection game" where you unlock and collect beautiful girls. Once unlocked, the girls are sealed within bottles, allowing you to reunite with them whenever you wish. Each girl features unique animations and voice lines, offering a truly immersive experience!

games.title: 勇闯华强北
games.description: 你今年22岁，大学刚毕业，但是马上就失业了。 你决定，带着大学4年积累下来的18000元， 冲进华强北，当一回背包客。 泪水打湿猪脚饭，发誓要赚一百万！

games.title: Gсhat
games.description: A free messenger for friends, communities and teams. Chats, voice and video calls, voice rooms you can drop into anytime, screen sharing, community servers with roles, and a task board for your team. One account on PC and phone. Sign in with Steam.

games.title: Kameko: Cosplay Love Story
games.description: Three women with very particular cosplay fetishes walk into your ordinary life and ask you to be their personal photographer — which means managing their careers, chasing their dreams, and running private sessions that stop being about the photos surprisingly quickly.

games.title: DualBeats
games.description: Notes flow in from both sides toward the center. Play solo with both hands, or team up with a friend on one screen. You never have to chase the notes themselves, so you can focus purely on the music. Build charts for your own songs with the built-in editor and share them easily as QR images.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.description: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
games.description: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

games.title: 007 First Light
games.description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.description: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

games.title: Detroit: Become Human
games.description: Detroit: Become Human puts the destiny of both mankind and androids in your hands, taking you to a near future where machines have become more intelligent than humans. Every choice you make affects the outcome of the game, with one of the most intricately branching narratives ever created.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.description: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.

games.title: BOMBANANA!
games.description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

games.title: ULTRAKILL
games.description: ULTRAKILL is a fast-paced ultra-violent retro FPS that combines the skill-based style scoring of character action games with the unadulterated carnage inspired by the best shooters of the '90s. Rip apart your foes with varied destructive weaponry and shower in their blood to regain your health.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.description: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.

games.title: Fallout 4
games.description: From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Starfield and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, comes Fallout 4. A landmark in open-world RPG design and winner of over 200 ‘Best Of’ honors, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year.

games.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
games.description: DOOM: The Dark Ages is the prequel to the critically acclaimed DOOM (2016) and DOOM Eternal that tells an epic cinematic story worthy of the DOOM Slayer’s legend. Players will step into the blood-stained boots of the DOOM Slayer, in this never-before-seen dark and sinister medieval war against Hell.

games.title: Starfield
games.description: Starfield is the first new universe in 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4.

games.title: Fallout: New Vegas
games.description: Welcome to Vegas. New Vegas. Enjoy your stay!

games.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition
games.description: The critically acclaimed RPG that raised the bar, from the creators of Baldur's Gate 3. Gather your party. Master deep, tactical combat. Venture as a party of up to four - but know that only one of you will have the chance to become a God.

games.title: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
games.description: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

games.title: Bread and Fred
games.description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

games.title: Strange Antiquities
games.description: Strange Antiquities is a game set in Undermere, where you explore occult artifacts and solve dark mysteries. As an apprentice thaumaturge, you'll identify magical items and help townsfolk. A sequel to Strange Horticulture, it blends exploration to uncover strange secrets.
